title: Engineering protein expression dynamics with Tet-ON and dTAG degron systems: from precise control to oscillations
authors: Noble B; Cottrell O; Rowntree A; Biga V; Woods F; Wang X; Papalopulu N; Miller A
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦于利用Tet-ON和dTAG系统工程化蛋白质表达动态与振荡，属于细胞工程与合成生物学范畴，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Precise temporal control of protein expression is essential for dissecting protein function and dynamic cellular processes. We present a framework for engineering tunable oscillatory protein expression (repeated pulses in expression) using widely adopted molecular tools, applying them to modulate NGN3 expression. Single-cell time-lapse microscopy reveals that the Tet-On system unexpectedly generates asynchronous oscillations in protein expression under continuous doxycycline administration. These oscillations are dependent on protein instability and are not tunable by doxycycline concentration. In contrast, the dTAG degron system enables precise, reversible, concentration-dependent control of protein degradation and reaccumulation. Coupled with a constitutive promoter, we achieve synchronous oscillatory protein expression (COD: C onstituitive promoter driving O scillations via D egradation). Mathematical modelling identifies optimal dTAG drug addition and removal timings using the COD system to flexibly tune NGN3 oscillation periods while maintaining other oscillatory parameters (mean level and peak-to-trough fold-change). Using microfluidics (COD+CHIPS) we reproduce model-predicted 5 and 10 hours periodicities while maintaining similar mean levels and peak-to-trough fold-changes. This work introduces a generalisable, programmable approach for generating and modulating protein oscillations, allowing investigation into how dynamic protein expression governs cellular function.
abstract_zh:
摘要

蛋白质表达的精确时间控制对于解析蛋白质功能和动态细胞过程至关重要。我们提出了一种框架，利用广泛采用的分子工具来工程化可调谐的振荡性蛋白质表达（表达中的重复脉冲），并将其应用于调节NGN3表达。单细胞延时显微镜揭示，在持续给予多西环素的情况下，Tet-On系统意外地产生蛋白质表达中的异步振荡。这些振荡依赖于蛋白质的不稳定性，且不受多西环素浓度调节。相比之下，dTAG降解系统能够实现对蛋白质降解和再积累的精确、可逆、浓度依赖性控制。结合组成型启动子，我们实现了同步振荡性蛋白质表达（COD：通过降解驱动振荡的组成型启动子）。数学模型识别出使用COD系统灵活调节NGN3振荡周期的最佳dTAG药物添加和移除时间，同时保持其他振荡参数（平均水平及峰谷倍数变化）不变。利用微流控技术（COD+CHIPS），我们重现了模型预测的5小时和10小时周期性，同时保持相似的平均水平和峰谷倍数变化。这项工作引入了一种可推广、可编程的方法来生成和调节蛋白质振荡，从而能够研究动态蛋白质表达如何调控细胞功能。
